policy.translationBoundary: Missing per-turn translations are preserved and must not be generated during ingress.
policy.sourceClaimBoundary: The source notes on 諗/想, 有冇, 邊隻, 點樣, 一定得, and 乜都 are pedagogical claims requiring independent verification.
policy.deduplicationBoundary: Exact and normalized repository matches are candidates until reviewed.
policy.evidenceBoundary: Dialog adjacency and pedagogical attestation do not establish productivity, construction identity, classifier rules, formula status, or parser behavior.

knownSourceAlerts.note: The email supplies Cantonese and Jyutping but no per-turn English translations.
Claims about 諗/想, 有冇, 邊隻, 點樣, 一定得, 乜都, and Confidence Level: High remain metadata rather than Canto Span adjudication.
有冇諗 and context-linked 有冇大計 require lexical, A-not-A, ellipsis, and discourse analysis.
去健身室做運動 and 用app同上堂 require bounded motion-purpose, instrumental, coordination, and ellipsis analysis.
邊隻語言 and 乜都睇 are preserved without accepting the source classifier or wh-plus-都 generalizations.
Weekly/monthly frequency and time-frame quantity strings require measure, aspect, topic, and fragment analysis.
一定得 is preserved as contextual encouragement without treating 得 as a single unrestricted ability construction.
Creation, echo fragments, habitual meeting questions, motion goals, and reciprocal rotation remain contextual attestations.
Large currency numerals, echo fragments, 少啲 scope, inferential fragments, and contextual comparatives require separate review.
